name: deliberation
description: Two-round multi-model deliberation panel: Gemini and GitHub Copilot debate a near-final draft (via deliberate.py), with a local Ollama model named at run time by the resolver as the fallback when Copilot does not answer, enriched with Consensus and optional Scopus.AI evidence, after which Claude arbitrates per the canonical protocol, validates new references against Scopus, and writes a Deliberation Log.
